options.content:
### 用 SQL 查看一天的降水与云层
**PARDIG + SatWeave** · 0.1° 原始网格 · GreptimeDB **v1.3.0** · InfluxDB 写入 → PostgreSQL 查询 → Grafana

选择**区域**、历史**时间范围**与**快照**。地图显示快照，曲线显示所选时段；**半径**只作用于中心点周边降水图。时间均为 UTC。

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(n) AS observations FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM pardig WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) UNION ALL SELECT count(*) AS n FROM satweave WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts))
SELECT max(rain_mm_h) AS peak FROM pardig WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts)
SELECT min(brightness_k) AS coldest FROM satweave WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: 降雨网格占比 · 快照

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN rain_mm_h >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(rain_mm_h),0) AS rainy FROM pardig WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND ts = CAST(${snapshot} AS TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: 降水分布 / 0.5° 网格最大值
panels.description: 仅对地图显示做空间聚合，数据库保留 0.1° 原始网格。悬停查看数值。红外亮温不是地面气温。

layers.name: 降水分布 / 0.5° 网格最大值

targets.rawSql: SELECT floor(latitude * 2) / 2 + 0.25 AS latitude, floor(longitude * 2) / 2 + 0.25 AS longitude, max(rain_mm_h) AS rain_mm_h FROM pardig WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND ts = CAST(${snapshot} AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY floor(latitude * 2), floor(longitude * 2)

panels.title: 红外亮温 / 0.5° 网格平均值
panels.description: 仅对地图显示做空间聚合，数据库保留 0.1° 原始网格。悬停查看数值。红外亮温不是地面气温。

layers.name: 红外亮温 / 0.5° 网格平均值

targets.rawSql: SELECT floor(latitude * 2) / 2 + 0.25 AS latitude, floor(longitude * 2) / 2 + 0.25 AS longitude, avg(brightness_k) AS brightness_k FROM satweave WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND ts = CAST(${snapshot} AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY floor(latitude * 2), floor(longitude * 2)

panels.title: 区域降水率 · 每 15 分钟
panels.description: 瞬时降水率，不是累计降水量。平均值为网格点算术平均，未做面积加权。

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, avg(rain_mm_h) AS mean_rate, max(rain_mm_h) AS peak_rate FROM pardig WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

panels.title: 区域亮温 · 每小时
panels.description: 卫星观测的大气顶亮温，不是地面气温。

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, min(brightness_k) AS coldest, avg(brightness_k) AS mean_brightness FROM satweave WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

panels.title: 中心点 ${radius} km 内的降水率
panels.description: 使用 WKT 点和 st_distance_sphere_m 计算球面距离。东亚中心为上海，湾区中心为旧金山；城市参数使用该城市中心。只统计已导入网格。

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, avg(rain_mm_h) AS local_mean, max(rain_mm_h) AS local_peak FROM pardig WHERE region_id = ${region:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND st_distance_sphere_m(wkt_point_from_latlng(latitude,longitude), wkt_point_from_latlng(${center_lat},${center_lon})) <= ${radius} * 1000 GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

panels.title: 降水热点 × 卫星观测
panels.description: 按相同 UTC 时间、区域和原始网格精确关联，不插值。空间关联不表示因果关系。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.latitude, p.longitude, p.rain_mm_h, s.brightness_k,
round(st_distance_sphere_m(wkt_point_from_latlng(p.latitude,p.longitude),wkt_point_from_latlng(${center_lat},${center_lon}))/1000,1) AS distance_km
FROM pardig p JOIN satweave s ON p.region_id=s.region_id AND p.grid_id=s.grid_id AND p.ts=s.ts
WHERE p.region_id=${region:sqlstring} AND s.region_id=${region:sqlstring}
AND p.ts=CAST(${snapshot} AS TIMESTAMP) AND s.ts=CAST(${snapshot} AS TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY p.rain_mm_h DESC, p.grid_id LIMIT 15

**加工：**区域与时间裁剪、m/h 转 mm/h、经度归一化、SQL 聚合及可视化。缺失值保留为 NULL。**实验数据，不属于官方气象预报或预警。**不代表数据提供方背书。地图底图：© OpenStreetMap contributors。
